step_dag.name: plan / proposal
step_dag.acceptance: proposal file in ~/reports quotes the ruling verbatim (who ruled, when, in what words), names the exact sections touched, and carries the full replacement text; paraphrase is a bounce

step_dag.name: drift check across the instruction surface
step_dag.acceptance: a comment lists every other statement of the changed rule across AGENTS.md, opencode.json, every skill, and every agent prompt, each marked updated-by-this-change, contradicts-it, or unaffected; complete against a fresh grep

step_dag.name: approval gate
step_dag.acceptance: the ruling is madchaz's, given in the opencode session (or a Hindsight-recorded authorization within its stated scope), recorded as a comment quoting it verbatim with its timestamp; no ruling, no edit; the workflow waits on this gate without looping. Muse's review of a proposed change is advice: recorded as a comment, it is never the approval and never a veto - if madchaz directs a change over Muse's objection, both are recorded and the direction proceeds

step_dag.name: apply the approved text (single editor)
step_dag.acceptance: AGENTS.md carries the approved text first; every derived surface the drift check listed shows the new text with the source hash it derived from; no file outside the list changed The orchestrator prompt is regenerated from the amended AGENTS.md in this step (hand-generated; its header cites the new AGENTS.md sha256).

step_dag.name: verify hashes and zero-grep
step_dag.acceptance: new sha256 of every touched file quoted and diffed against the approved proposal; the orchestrator prompt generation header matches the new AGENTS.md hash; grep for the superseded text returns zero across the surface

step_dag.name: close with the dual write
step_dag.acceptance: closing comment carries the ruling, the files, and old hash -> new hash per file; if the change touches a standing gate, the gates record is updated in this step
